description: Implement global resource_permissions-backed source ACLs for Disk sharing with Everyone public grants, inherited folder permissions, and immediate document permission synchronization. Legacy document/folder public tags were removed: existing tags are migrated to Everyone grants before documents.tags and folder_settings are dropped; access tests and current ingestion docs now use ACL-only semantics. Validation: focused ACL suites 209/209, search integration 4/4, migration up/down/up, mix q. Full precommit was not rerun after the final nil-person fix; the four previously failing locations pass targeted validation.
title: [source-acl] Implement source-backed sharing ACLs
